action: Establish the architecture constraint from the prior parity qualification before design freeze
outputs: finding distributed to design council P1/P2/P3
result: MATERIAL FINDING. A full-corpus parity audit on THIS host returned NEW_CLOUD_HOST_PARITY_FAILED (PARITY_PASS false): 530 sealed ARM worlds replayed through the x86 classifier gave N_MATCH 527, N_MISMATCH 1, ERROR_COUNT 2. ROOT CAUSE IS NOT ARCHITECTURE: SIMPLIFY_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=5 is a WALL-CLOCK budget, so a canonicalisation completing in 4.80s on x86 exceeded it on ARM, and the same unmodified classifier assigned a different scientific label to the same expression purely from host speed (artifact records not_floating_point=true). Affected field is first_loss_stage, the routing-relevant one. Exposure: 834 SIMPLIFY_TIMEOUT rows across 237 of 530 worlds (44.7%); the artifact states 1/530 is a LOWER BOUND because lazy replay short-circuits. CRITICAL CONNECTION: this is the same pathology I isolated as the root cause of Defect B in the sealed Gate 1 work, and the determinacy bound already built and validated there (scripts/e2b_bounded_determinacy_evaluator.py, 101/101 vs uncapped ground truth, 0 indeterminate) removes it by construction, since a cap can only produce UNRESOLVED and never a class. Also established: the parity audit REPLAYED sealed ARM candidate rows through the x86 classifier; it did NOT re-run PySR search on x86 and compare fronts to ARM. Cross-architecture SEARCH equivalence therefore remains UNPROVEN and is now an explicit question put to the governance adversary.

action: Independently verify P2's instrument-artifact finding before acting on it
authority: Prompt section 14/15 (verify a critic's finding independently)
result: VERIFIED, and it is material. MECHANISM: lazy_classify._g2_correct passes classification.effective_support=None straight into classify_support when canonicalisation did not return OK, so a SIMPLIFY_TIMEOUT yields SUPPORT_UNRESOLVED -> not SUCCESS -> g2_correct=False DETERMINISTICALLY. A wall-clock timer therefore decides a scientific label, and it does so MONOTONICALLY in one direction: toward 'no correct row', i.e. toward earlier-stage loss. QUANTIFICATION (my own recomputation, not P2's numbers): the classify cache holds 52,450 distinct expressions of which 397 are SIMPLIFY_TIMEOUT; 396 timed-out front rows appear in the corpus. Worlds containing at least one timed-out front row, by sealed first_loss_stage: A 73/122 = 59.8%, B 20/196 = 10.2%, C 3/102 = 2.9%, E 1/119 = 0.8%. The contamination is 75x more prevalent in stage-A worlds than stage-E worlds and is monotone in exactly the direction the mechanism predicts. E2a's attribution -- the measurement that disagreed with E2b and triggered the Gate 1 falsification -- is therefore substantially contaminated by a host-speed instrument artifact. SCHEMA CHECK: E2a rows persist expression_string and retained_by_argmax_score but NOT score/loss/g2_correct/canonicalization_status/admissibility, and all carry classified=false. Re-scoring is therefore FEASIBLE from primary data (expressions plus the persisted retention decision) and is re-measurement, NOT field fabrication under D6.
next: Highest-value next action is P2's BC-0: re-score the existing E2a fronts under the bounded determinacy instrument with ZERO new symbolic search, to establish whether the E2a/E2b divergence is real or an instrument artifact. Must freeze the diagnostic protocol results-blind first, reusing existing frozen divergence criteria rather than inventing one.

action: Independently verify the composition-mismatch explanation for the E2a/E2b divergence
authority: Prompt section 15 (verify, do not average) + section 4 council synthesis
result: VERIFIED AND MATERIAL. E2a is a BALANCED factorial (5 truth families at ~20% each: affine 108, saturating 108, interaction 108, exponential 108, power 107). Held-out G2 is NOT: affine 108 = 75.0%, saturating 12 = 8.3%, interaction 12 = 8.3%, exponential 12 = 8.3%, and mass_power ZERO = 0%. E2a's two most over-represented families are degenerate at opposite extremes: mass_power is 107/107 SUCCESS (stage E = 1.000) and has NO Held-out representation at all, while mass_exponential is 108/108 stage A (never-on-front) at 20% of E2a versus 8.3% of Held-out. Direct-standardising E2a's sealed per-family stage rates to the Held-out family mix moves stage A from 0.226 to 0.094 against Held-out's 0.097 -- a near-exact match -- and cuts total-variation distance over the four-way partition from 0.322 (46.4 cases of 144) to 0.103 (14.8 cases), removing 68.1% of the divergence by composition ALONE, with no instrument correction applied. DISAGREEMENT LOGGED, NOT AVERAGED: P3 reported the routing argmax flips B->C under standardisation. My computation says it does NOT flip -- standardised B = 0.466 versus C+D = 0.394, so retention remains the plurality while the gap narrows. Held-out has retention 0.382 vs cross-seed 0.493. Query sent to P3 to isolate whether its flip additionally required the timeout correction or used a different standardisation support. The sealed record will carry whichever survives reconciliation.

action: Resolve the P3 disagreement and verify the reversal it produced
result: DISAGREEMENT RESOLVED, AND IT REVERSES A CLAIM IN MY OWN FAVOUR'S OPPOSITE DIRECTION. P3 withdrew both contested claims after I challenged them. (1) The standardisation argmax does NOT flip; P3 reproduced my exact figures (A 0.0941, B 0.4660, C 0.3935, E 0.0463; TV 14.78 cases; 68.1% reduction) and traced its own differing numbers to conditioning within the noise_sd=0.02 stratum; it also withdrew its '91% reduction' as an arithmetic error (it had attached a conditional P_win|retain reduction to the TV figure). Corrected joint statement: composition explains 68-77% of the magnitude depending on conditioning, leaves 10.7-14.8 cases residual -- ABOVE the 10-case tolerance under BOTH conditionings -- and the ORDERING is not identified on E2a at any conditioning (both CIs cover zero). (2) THE DETERMINACY CLAIM REVERSES. P3's published interval B in [176,269], C in [99,195] was an over-approximation of the reachable set. I verified the corrected reachability myself: under the frozen witness order, A->C/E and B->C/E both require a RETAINED row to flip, and timeouts land on a retained row in only 2 A-worlds, 0 B-worlds, 3 C-worlds, 1 E-world. So 71 of 73 contaminated A-worlds can reach B and no further, and the 20 contaminated B-worlds cannot move at all. Refined bounds: A in [49,122], B in [196,267], C in [102,104], E in [119,121]. B_min=196 > max(A_max=122, C_max=104, E_max=121)=122, so the Gate 2 predicate (B>A AND B>C+D) is CAP-INVARIANT. E2a's LOCKED_EXECUTE_E4A WAS determinate on its own corpus. It remains stripped of forward-licensing force by D5 on composition/role grounds, and this analysis must NOT be cited for measurement indeterminacy.

action: Locate the actual repair: E4f's frozen state, and the legitimacy of freezing its ceilings NOW
authority: Prompt section 2 (authority to create missing E4f operational details) + section 2 condition A (before the governed result is observed)
result: The protocol pre-labels row 5 (route C+D -> E4f) non-executable for a GOOD reason, which it states plainly: 'Inventing those ceilings after the route is known is prohibited.' That reasoning is correct and it explicitly anticipates the tempting move. BUT it is not the end of the analysis. VERIFIED: E4f's STRUCTURE is already frozen -- arms K0/K1/K2 (classifier) and V0/V1/V2 (voting relation, V0 = template_key CONTROL), the metric ORDER (false_labelling_rate FIRST, then coverage, then k_inflation), the dependency (E2), and critically the cost: '0 new search (post hoc)', i.e. E4f is a RE-SCORING experiment costing nothing beyond re-scoring existing fronts. What is genuinely absent is only the NUMERIC ceilings -- the phrases appear, a number never does. Since the route is NOT yet known, NOW is the only moment at which those ceilings can legitimately be fixed, and prompt section 2 explicitly delegates authority to create 'missing E4f operational details' provided the decision precedes the result it governs. Commissioned accordingly, with the design constraint that it must NOT invent an absolute number: E4f's own frozen K0/V0 CONTROL arms permit a CONTROL-RELATIVE non-inferiority criterion with zero free absolute parameters, and the arms re-score THE SAME fronts so the comparison is naturally PAIRED.
